results.reasoning: constantly(끊임없이) fits 'solving problems' ongoing action. rarely(거의~않다) fits 'let alone' negation. awareness(인식) fits 'without awareness'.
characterized(특징짓다) fits academic description. extending(확장하는) fits broadening scope to children. solved(해결된) fits 'solving problems' theme.
procedures(절차) fits 'learning by experiment'. conversation(대화) fits 'use words'. contexts(맥락) fits 'language occurs in contexts'.
forget(잊다) contradicts remember parallel — original learn. Other markers match fullPassage.
give up(포기하다) contradicts context of children discovering — original figure out.
eagerly(열심히) contradicts 'let alone' structure implying minimal action — original rarely.
solving _____ → problems. Entire passage revolves around problem-solving.
_____ rules work → grammatical. Context: words, meaning, language.
all _____ language-learning → infant. Later: 'an infant must make sense'.
constantly ≈ continually. Both mean 'all the time/without cease'.
characterized ≈ described. 'Characterized A as B' = 'described A as B'.
rarely ≈ seldom. Both indicate very low frequency.
extending ↔ restricting. Extending=widening scope; restricting=narrowing scope.
awareness ↔ oblivion. Awareness=conscious knowledge; oblivion=complete unawareness.
(A) make sense OF the data = comprehend/interpret. (B) didn't make sense = wasn't logical/coherent.
scientist + human mind + behavior = psychologist. Definition is textbook psychology.
Participle clause after comma: characterized..., extending → present participle.
the ___(mean) of → noun position after determiner → meaning.
learn, remember, or ___ something → make sense of. Parallel structure with cognitive verbs.
rarely explain X, ___ Y → let alone. 'Let alone' = 'much less/not to mention'.
